repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability and cost-tracking dashboard for AI coding agents.
bullets: Built with Python to provide granular visibility into agentic workflows.
Tracks specific metrics including token consumption, latency, file modifications, and test execution results.
Provides a transparent audit trail for developers to optimize agent performance and manage operational costs.
Integrates directly with popular coding agents like Claude Code and Codex to visualize work steps.
repos.img_alt: agentacct tui — live usage, cost, provider rate-limit bars, and recent sessions with per-session weekly-plan-cost estimates
repos.img2_alt: agentacct tui session detail — the per-step work ledger with pass/fail check evidence and a weekly-plan-cost estimate

repos.name: EthanXiang777/circuit-framework
repos.description: Circuit Framework — multi-agent LLM trading research system
repos.one_liner: A specialized multi-agent framework designed for LLM-based quantitative trading research.
bullets: Python-based architecture optimized for modular agent interaction in financial contexts.
Facilitates complex research workflows by orchestrating multiple agents to handle data analysis, strategy backtesting, and signal generation.
Designed to bridge the gap between high-level LLM reasoning and rigorous quantitative financial modeling.
Enables researchers to iterate on trading hypotheses using agentic workflows rather than manual scripting.

repos.name: simonlin1212/vibe-astock
repos.description: A 股短线复盘看板：涨停池·连板梯队·龙虎榜·板块资金一屏看完，赚钱效应/晋级率/梯队断层/情绪周期等派生指标纯计算直出（不经过 AI），AI 只把数据串成能读的盘面研判。全本地运行，可用 Claude/Codex 订阅免 API key。| A-share short-term daily-review dashboard: derived sentiment metrics computed locally, AI only writes the narrative. No API key needed.
repos.one_liner: A local-first A-share market sentiment and daily-review dashboard for quantitative traders.
bullets: Uses a hybrid approach: pure mathematical computation for market metrics and AI for narrative synthesis.
Calculates proprietary sentiment indicators like 'money-making effect' and 'ladder gaps' locally without external API dependencies.
Provides a comprehensive visual dashboard for short-term market analysis, including limit-up pools and capital flow tracking.
Supports local LLM integration (Claude/Codex) to interpret raw data into actionable market insights.
